audience: training managers and L&D teams that run courses in iSpring Learn

useCases.title: Check the enrollments of a learner
useCases.text: Find a user and list the enrollments with the status of each course.

useCases.title: Review the content library
useCases.text: List the content items and read one item with its modules.

useCases.title: See who finished a course
useCases.text: Read the final statuses of a content item to see who passed and who did not.

useCases.title: Review the org structure
useCases.text: List the departments, the groups and the roles of the account.
